bullets.text: Regulators Propose Crypto Rules — The SEC and Financial Accounting Standards Board introduced proposals to regulate crypto assets, aiming to clarify capital-raising pathways for entrepreneurs, impacting the crypto industry significantly.

Legacy Systems Costly — Outdated payment infrastructures are hindering banks' efficiency and profitability, with hidden costs often exceeding maintenance expenses, affecting financial institutions across Europe.

FCA Supports Innovative Firms — The Financial Conduct Authority has launched a Scale-up Unit to assist five fast-growing UK fintech firms, helping them navigate regulation and promote sustainable growth.

Revolut Launches Stablecoin — Revolut introduced a euro-pegged stablecoin, EURR, in three countries, marking a significant step in integrating cryptocurrencies into mainstream finance for European users.

Stripe Acquires OpenRouter — Stripe's acquisition of OpenRouter aims to enhance AI integration for businesses, allowing better management of AI-related expenses and positioning Stripe as a leader in AI economic infrastructure.
